完整覆盖 Launcher、客户端上传与发布、后台和认证接口。文档可见不等于拥有: Covers Launcher, client uploads and publishing, administration and authentication. Reading documentation does not grant business permissions.
后台完整规范包含 Launcher、客户端自动化、后台和认证接口。文档可见性不授: The complete panel reference includes Launcher, client automation, administration and authentication. Documentation access grants no business permissions. Each request still checks scope, RBAC, revisions and lifecycle. Follow upload, review, build and publication stages using actual progress.
JSON 编码选区文本：left、top、width、height 为 0–1: JSON-encoded crop text: left, top, width and height are ratios from 0 to 1; width and height must be positive.
JSON 编码的当前对象键，首次上传填写文本 null。: JSON-encoded current object key. For a first upload enter the text null.
HTTP {0}：参数、会话、权限、资源状态或基础设施错误。: HTTP {0}: parameter, session, permission, resource-state or infrastructure error.
mua_session 会话设置或清除，由浏览器管理。: Sets or clears mua_session, managed by the browser.
Cookie 写请求要求同源 Origin；Bearer 写请求不要求 Orig: Cookie writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer writes do not. An Authorization header selects Bearer exclusively; an invalid token never falls back to Cookie. JSON is required; use {} for actions that ignore the parsed body.
写请求要求同源 Origin，Bearer 不能替代 Cookie。除图片上传外: Writes require same-origin Origin; Bearer cannot replace Cookie. Use application/json with a body except for image uploads.
仅 Cookie 写请求必需；浏览器自动发送真实 Origin。: Required for Cookie writes only. Browsers send their actual Origin automatically.
当前网站的完整 origin；浏览器自动发送。: The current site's complete origin, sent automatically by browsers.
成功；字段可见性仍受当前 RBAC 和资源状态约束。: Success; field visibility remains subject to current RBAC and resource state.
当前提供 5 个 Launcher 公开读取接口。客户端自动化、后台及认证接口将: Five public Launcher read endpoints are documented. Client automation, administration and authentication contracts will be added in later stages.
API 文档加载失败，请刷新后重试。: Could not load the API reference. Refresh the page to try again.
后台使用 HttpOnly 会话 Cookie；写操作还要求同源 Origin。: Administration uses an HttpOnly session cookie; writes also require a same-origin Origin header. Establish browser sessions through login rather than manually entering cookies.
客户端自动化接口使用 Bearer mua_…；不是 JWT。Token 受服务: Client automation uses Bearer mua_... tokens, not JWTs. Tokens are restricted by server scope, permissions, expiry and the account's current RBAC. They do not authenticate administration endpoints.
参数格式无效，或基准摘要缺少基准发布 ID。: Invalid parameter format, or a base manifest digest without a base release ID.
资源未公开、已归档／删除／解绑，或所需文件／平台产物不可用。: The resource is not public, has been archived, deleted or unbound, or the required file/platform artifact is unavailable.
固定下载包摘要不匹配；必须重新建立下载任务，不能续传到其他字节。: The fixed package digest no longer matches. Start a new download task; do not resume with different bytes.
当前发布格式不在 acceptedFormatVersions 中；不会自动选择: The current release format is not accepted by acceptedFormatVersions. No historical release is selected automatically.
服务或数据库暂时不可用。: The service or database is temporarily unavailable.
已发布清单、基准或 OSS 产物不可读取，或身份／大小／摘要校验失败。: The published manifest, base or storage artifact is unreadable, or identity, size or digest validation failed.
只返回已上架、未归档且绑定有效发布的服务器，按 sortOrder、server: Returns listed, unarchived servers with a valid bound release, ordered by sortOrder and serverId. Display windows include their start and exclude their end. Expiry hides directory entries only; manifests, downloads and refreshes for otherwise online resources remain available. Times are ISO 8601 strings with a timezone.
公开服务器目录；没有可见服务器时 servers 为 []。: Public server directory. When no servers are visible, servers is [].
获取当前发布的原始清单: Get the original current release manifest
原始发布清单及 Ed25519 签名响应头。: Original release manifest with Ed25519 signature headers.
原始响应字节的 SHA-256。: SHA-256 of the original response bytes.
发布清单签名；与包内 mua-pack.json 的独立签名不同。: Release manifest signature, distinct from the independent signature of mua-pack.json inside the archive.
返回 JSON 下载描述，不直接返回 ZIP。full 永远指向同目标完整包。链: Returns a JSON download descriptor, not ZIP bytes. full always points to the complete package for the same target. Links normally expire after 300 seconds. etag is the original object storage value, including quotes, or null; it is not SHA-256. Use the relative refreshUrl to renew links. Storage GET supports a single Range and If-Match; browsers still require storage CORS. Verify size, SHA-256 and archive signatures after download. Signature parameters depend on the storage provider. Do not modify signed URLs or use a GET URL for HEAD.
刷新固定发布版本的下载链接: Refresh download links for a fixed release
发现当前发布的完整包或更新包: Discover a full or update package for the current release
releaseId 固定为当前在线绑定客户端的未归档发布，允许该客户端历史版本刷: releaseId identifies an unarchived release of the currently online bound client. Historical releases of that client can be refreshed without selecting the latest release. packageSha256 is optional but is always included in generated refreshUrl values; a mismatch returns 409. Archival or unbinding blocks new refreshes, but previously signed links may remain usable until expiry.
v1、新 v2 或历史 v2 的 full／update 下载描述。: A full/update download descriptor for v1, new v2 or historical v2.
当前站点；本地、预览和生产使用各自的同源 API。: Current site. Local, preview and production deployments use their own same-origin API.
服务器发现、发布清单与下载链接。无需登录；资源公开条件仍由后端逐请求校验。: Server discovery, release manifests and download links. No login is required; the backend checks public resource eligibility on every request.
v1 必须提供六项规范平台之一。v2 protocolRevision:2 不限: v1 requires a canonical platform. v2 protocolRevision:2 is platform independent and serves the same recipe on every system. Platform rules do not certify game launch compatibility.
acceptedFormatVersions 必填，可传 1、2、1,2 或 2: acceptedFormatVersions is required: 1, 2, 1,2 or 2,1. baseReleaseId must identify the publication pinned at upload; include baseManifestSha256 when available. Mismatches select full for the same target. v1 uses the packaged platform manifest digest; v2 uses the original recipe manifest digest. Corrupt baselines fail.
v1 或 v2 的 full／update 下载描述。: Full or update download descriptor for v1 or v2.
公开规范描述 4 个 Launcher 读取接口；客户端自动化、后台及认证接口见: The public specification describes four Launcher read operations. Client automation, administration and authentication are in the protected full specification. API route v1, muapack formatVersion and document versions are independent. Examples, generated clients and online requests follow this declared scope.
返回已封存的原始 JSON 字节，保持签名对应的编码，不能重新序列化后验签。v1: Returns sealed original JSON bytes. Verify the signature against these bytes without reserialization. v1 returns mua-client-manifest schemaVersion:2; its digest is not the packaged platform manifest digest. v2 returns mua-recipe-manifest. Obtain public keys through a trusted channel; a key ID does not establish trust.
